_comment: Only needed if Android Studio doesn't pick up the app repo's .mcp.json (see the MCP servers section of .github/workflow-guide.md). Copy the servers you need into Android Studio's own mcp.json (Settings > Tools > GitHub Copilot > MCP, or the chat's tools menu > Edit mcp.json). Keep the server names as they are: the agents look tools up by them (atlassian-rovo/*, repowise/*). The Authorization header is only for API-token sign-in; leave requestInit out to sign in through the browser instead. Never commit a filled-in mcp.json.
